_note: Model catalogue of the orchestrator. Keys are never stored here but in .env under api_key_env. pi_builtin: pi knows the model itself (prices, compat); it is only redirected to the proxy. Own pricing entries (USD per 1M tokens) take precedence over pi's registry. tariff: peak windows in UTC; outside them offpeak_factor applies.

tariff.note: DeepSeek: half price outside peak hours. Chinese public holidays (also off-peak there) are billed as peak time, so the costs are an upper bound.

models.note: Prices in the pi registry = peak tariff
